preflight_v14_diagnostic.failure: The logger began finalization while the detector and manager could still publish. The final fused correction therefore had no terminal planner outcome; terminal_stop_verified and producer_quiescence_acknowledged were false. The route outcome is retained only as diagnostic evidence and cannot release the final campaign.

terminal_stop_and_quiescence_amendment.scope: evidence lifecycle only; no detector, measurement, planner, controller, route, noise, threshold or statistical-design value changed
terminal_stop_and_quiescence_amendment.protocol: The experiment logger publishes one immutable request after its terminal decision. The planner latches the request and publishes a zero command before acknowledging. The camera manager and detector stop accepting/producing work, append a request-bound durable session_stopped marker, and then acknowledge. The logger commits a summary only after all three identity-bearing acknowledgements, a complete correction ledger, a forwarded zero command and a 0.25-s operational stationary window, or records an explicit invalid timeout.
terminal_stop_and_quiescence_amendment.operational_reference_only: Stationarity uses planner-belief displacement and applied-command outcomes. Ground truth remains offline and is not part of termination or release control.

verification.ros_build_command: colcon build --symlink-install --base-paths src --packages-select unav_common planning reliability perception experiments

additional_identity_checks: terminal stop acknowledgement status matches the owning component
detector and manager final journal markers contain the summary terminal_stop_request_id
the campaign runner rejects a summary whose evidence_complete, terminal_stop_verified or producer_quiescence_acknowledged field is present and false
preflight_release_gate.failure_policy: Do not launch the final campaign unless every V7 and V8 gate passes. Preserve failure and freeze another amendment before retrying.

prohibitions: Do not use any preflight as navigation comparison evidence.
Do not lower detector, image-border, hull, NIS, motion-support, route-support or clearance gates.
Do not use ground truth online.
Do not edit the reused V12 preflight or V9 final campaign configurations.
